e8b_superseded_evidence.purpose: an explicit, dated map of every E8B analysis that has been superseded or invalidated, what replaced it, and why. History is preserved, not rewritten: no commit is amended and no incorrect analysis is erased.

records.item: commit 998be0c, message diagnosis of the grid point 3 G14 halt
records.claimed: row 3101 margin 4.768e-07, brute-versus-cached difference 2.801e-06, and 'all three scorers agree on the scores'
records.actual: under the corrected shared-prefix method the margin is 3.5167e-06 and the brute perturbation is 1.604e-04; the scorers do NOT agree
records.why_wrong: the figures came from single-row prefixes while the canonical scores came from batch-128 prefixes, so batch composition was confounded with the scorer
records.note: the commit is left exactly as written; git history is not rewritten. This record is the correction.

records.item: g14_numerical_characterization.json (v1)
records.note: the raw JSON was deleted rather than quarantined and is unrecoverable, as is its generating script. Recorded as a procedural failure that cost auditability.

records.item: the plateau 'run-length-free reversal' claim
records.why_wrong: the statistic was the mean of each run's top n-minus-7 epochs, so its window depended on run length and it was not run-length free; it was also conditioned on the outcome variable and constructed after the results were seen
records.actual: under a genuinely length-free statistic, the mean of the top 16 epochs for all three runs, the ordering is 0.53322, 0.53123 and 0.51205, the SAME as the ordering by maximum
records.SUPERSEDED_BY: record 'the mean of top 16 replacement statistic' below (added 2026-08-07 under the fixed-22 amendment, F3)
records.FORWARD_POINTER: DO NOT READ THE 'actual' FIELD BELOW AS A LIVE RANKING CLAIM. Its historical text is preserved verbatim, but the replacement statistic it cites (mean of top 16) was itself INVALIDATED: its selection pools were the runs' own 30, 21 and 16 epochs, so selection into the top k remained length-dependent. NO ordering claim from Grids 1-3 survives in either direction.

records.item: the unsourced McNemar figures (p 0.88, 0.44, 0.54)
records.why_wrong: no generating code and no retained per-row data existed; the same document's OI3 said the data was not kept
records.actual: exact binomial McNemar from persisted per-row vectors: p 0.9040, 0.4858, 0.5616 with discordant counts 2475, 2522 and 2327

records.item: the claim that identity verification covered the rotary buffers
records.status: WITHDRAWN, and the underlying defect FIXED
records.why_wrong: no code had ever inspected those buffers, and the claim was false for B3 whose fp32 inv_freq does not round-trip through bfloat16
records.actual: B2 carried a bfloat16-truncated rotary table while B3 kept fp32, an uncontrolled difference inside the primary B3 minus B2 contrast
records.replaced_by: restore_rotary_fp32 and assert_lm_buffer_parity; both arms now reconstruct the table in fp32 from the same pinned configuration, verified bitwise

records.item: grid points 1, 2 and 3 (the abandoned search)
records.why: selected on BF16 development accuracy under a superseded evaluation rule, with unequal epoch counts (30, 21, 16) under patience-based early stopping
records.prohibition: never a core result; no hyperparameter winner is claimed; no between-point difference is evidence of recipe superiority

records.item: the BF16 64-row G14 and its 1e-4 informational tolerance
records.replaced_by: g14_fp32_gate with the frozen P + L + O construction

records.item: determinism_probe_run1.json, run2.json and determinism_probe_comparison.json
records.status: SUPERSEDED - the strict-determinism label was false
records.why_wrong: TWO silent downgrade paths reset warn_only to True after enable_strict_determinism. First, the probe called utils.set_seed AFTER imposing strict determinism. Second, and structurally, build_arm re-seeds internally because G13 requires a re-seed immediately before trunk construction, and utils.set_seed is shared with every experiment and unconditionally sets warn_only=True. Runs 1 and 2 therefore executed under warn_only=True, which is the silent fallback the amendment forbids.
records.what_still_holds: their bit-for-bit agreement is real, but it evidences only that the deterministic math attention backend is reproducible under warn_only=True, a weaker claim than was made
records.replaced_by: determinism_probe_run3.json, run4.json and determinism_probe_comparison_strict.json, which record verified_at_use with warn_only=False and are bit-for-bit identical
records.fix: reseed_strict and assert_strict_determinism; enforcement is re-imposed after every seeding point and the flag is re-read at the point of use, so a downgrade raises instead of passing
records.carried_forward: any future core trainer must repeat this discipline, because it too must call build_arm

records.item: the 'mean of top 16' replacement statistic (the second plateau statistic)
records.why_wrong: its selection pools are the runs' own 30, 21 and 16 epochs, so selection into the top k remains length-dependent; it is not length-free either
records.consequence: the sentence in protocol_amendment_20260807_fp32.json A2.withdrawn_claim stating the ordering is 'the SAME as the ordering by maximum' under that statistic is WITHDRAWN as a ranking claim; no ordering claim in either direction is made from Grids 1-3
records.replaced_by: no statistic. Abandonment rests on the persisted McNemar tests and the seed-spread comparison only.

records.item: the G19 multiplier and projection blocks inside pilot_e8b_B3_train_40k_seed0_search1.json and search2.json
records.status: SUPERSEDED for all current resource planning
records.why_superseded: they assume a live eight-point search (abandoned), a 15/22 expected-epoch basis (replaced by the fixed 22 for B2/B3), U4 promotion (withdrawn), and BF16-era per-epoch rates (superseded by the strict-deterministic FP32 design measured at 78.0 s/epoch against their 53.88)
records.what_remains_valid: their MEASURED timings remain honest historical observations of what those runs cost under the then-current design (53.88 s train, 84.94/85.39 s BF16 eval per epoch, 1.379 h and 1.035 h wall). Their search and core PROJECTIONS are invalid under the abandoned-search, fixed-22, FP32-core protocol.

records.item: the causal claim that strict determinism alone caused the observed ~45 per cent runtime increase
records.why_wrong: 78.0 versus 53.88 s/epoch is the TOTAL cost of the amended execution design relative to the superseded one. Three changes were made simultaneously - the deterministic math SDPA backend, the fp32 frozen-model instance, and the added enforcement assertions - and no experiment isolated their individual contributions.
records.correct_statement: the amended design costs about 45 per cent more per training epoch than the superseded one; the split between its three simultaneous changes is unmeasured

records.item: the BF16 best-epoch and development results of search grid points 1 and 2 (best_dev_r1_accuracy 0.5385 at epoch 20; 0.53824 at epoch 11; their per-epoch histories and selected_checkpoint_reproduced_accuracy fields)
records.status: EXPLORATORY, NON-CANONICAL, NOT COMPARABLE to final core results
records.why: they were produced under BF16 evaluation, which the FP32 amendment made non-canonical, and selected by max-over-epochs, which the fixed-22 amendment removed from the primary protocol. Their run lengths (30 and 21 epochs) were set by patience, which no core cell uses.
records.prohibition: never quoted beside, or compared with, a final FP32 epoch-22 core figure; never used to select the recipe or support a superiority claim in either direction
records.replaced_by: no replacement. The final core matrix produces its own FP32 epoch-22 figures.

records.item: the wall time of the SUPERSEDED determinism probe runs 1 and 2
records.status: SUPERSEDED as evidence, but HONESTLY STILL CHARGED as spent compute
records.note: runs 1 and 2 are superseded because their strict-determinism label was false (they executed under warn_only=True). The GPU time they consumed was nonetheless really spent on the pretrained checkpoint, so core_resource_projection.py spent_compute() charges runs 1 THROUGH 4 to the pretrained identity. Superseding the evidence does not refund the hours.
records.replaced_by: determinism_probe_run3/run4 and determinism_probe_comparison_strict.json for the EVIDENCE; the hours remain charged

records.item: docs/experiments/e8a_phase1a_pilot.md and docs/experiments/e8a_phase1b_a0p.md, the E8B-multiplier paragraphs
superseded_claims: 'the E8B per-epoch multiplier ... remains the back-solved assumption 2.931 to 8.004'
'B3 is an E8B arm with no measurement anywhere in this repository'
records.why: E8B has run: grid points 1-3 executed on 2026-08-06/07, and the measured multiplier was 9.091/9.121 under the superseded BF16 design - ABOVE the assumed 8.004 upper bound - and is superseded again by the amended FP32 strict-deterministic design
records.handling: the historical documents are NOT rewritten; dated supersession notes are appended in place pointing to the current records

records.item: FIRST INDEPENDENT HASH ANCHORS for two previously unhashed historical artefacts
records.important_caveat: these hashes were NOT recorded at the artefacts' creation time. They are the FIRST independent hash anchors, computed at the current clean tracked repository state on 2026-08-07. Git history is the prior integrity anchor: both files are tracked and the worktree was clean when the hashes were taken.
records.why_unhashed_before: grid point 3 halted at the post-selection G14 BEFORE its result record was written, so the record that would normally carry its checkpoint hashes never existed; and no record ever hashed the halt file itself.

records.item: the wording 'no search execution path exists anywhere'
records.precise_statement: no authorised search TRAINING path exists at any entry: train_search_point, train_pilot and _train_locked are deleted, and every remaining optimizer path carries its own execution-class authorisation. Historical READ-ONLY diagnostic paths DO remain for provenance and reproduction - build_recipe, SEARCH_GRID, and the search-checkpoint readers in fp32_canonical_validation.py and g14_numerical_characterization.py - and each carries a READ-ONLY SUPERSEDED DIAGNOSTIC banner and contains no optimizer, backward pass or parameter update.

e8b_superseded_evidence.completeness_statement: this map aims to cover every E8B analysis superseded or invalidated to date. It is APPENDED to, never rewritten: historical record text is preserved verbatim and corrections are added as new records or as explicit forward pointers on the original.
